documents.title: Harborline Systems, Inc. — Confidential Information Memorandum (Excerpt)
documents.triage_summary: Seller marketing material summarising management's presentation of Harborline's financial performance, revenue quality, customer metrics, contracts, adjusted EBITDA, working capital and growth strategy. Useful for identifying seller-made claims and routing those claims to stronger underlying evidence.

documents.title: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems, Inc. and Northwind Retail Group, Inc.
documents.triage_summary: Executed customer master services agreement for Northwind Retail Group setting out term, renewal, fees, assignment/change-of-control, liability and service-credit provisions. Primary source evidence for contractual terms affecting customer-specific legal and commercial diligence.

documents.title: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems, Inc. and Vantage Grocers LLC
documents.triage_summary: Executed customer master services agreement for Vantage Grocers covering term, auto-renewal, most-favoured-customer pricing, service levels, termination remedies and assignment. Primary source for evaluating customer-specific pricing and renewal-related contractual exposure.

documents.title: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems, Inc. and Pinnacle Outdoor Brands, Inc.
documents.triage_summary: Executed customer master services agreement for Pinnacle Outdoor Brands addressing term, renewal, strategic discount, pricing escalator and assignment. Primary evidence for this account's commercial terms and discount governance context.

documents.title: RESELLER AND DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems, Inc. and Atlas Distribution GmbH
documents.triage_summary: Executed reseller and distribution agreement with Atlas Distribution establishing exclusivity, territory restrictions, minimum commitments, termination economics and assignment terms. Primary source for channel conflict and territorial exclusivity analysis.

documents.title: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems, Inc. and Cascade Foods Holdings LLC
documents.triage_summary: Executed customer master services agreement for Cascade Foods Holdings documenting re-engagement after a prior agreement lapsed, revised discounting, onboarding credit and assignment terms. Primary evidence for customer history and current contract economics.

documents.title: Customer Contract Summary — Top Accounts
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems - Office of the CFO
documents.triage_summary: Management-prepared summary of top customer and reseller contracts, including ACV, expiry, renewal and selected legal/commercial flags. Useful as a routing aid and to identify management representations, but underlying executed agreements are stronger evidence.

documents.title: Adjusted EBITDA Bridge — Management View
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems - Office of the CFO
documents.triage_summary: Management-prepared adjusted EBITDA bridge and adjustment schedule showing reported EBITDA, proposed add-backs and rationale. Useful for earnings challenge work because it states management's adjustments and indicates where supporting evidence may be needed.

documents.title: Board of Directors — Minutes (Extract), 22 October 2025
documents.prepared_by: not supported by the data room
documents.triage_summary: Board minutes extract documenting internal discussion of customer risk, contract consent requirements, MFN review, recurring legal settlements, European strategy constraints and collections pressure. Useful for cross-checking management narratives against internal governance records.

documents.title: IT and Data Systems Overview
documents.triage_summary: Management-prepared overview of application architecture, data/reporting environment, operational constraints, security posture, uptime and technology roadmap. Useful for technology diligence and for testing management's operational and growth assertions against current system capabilities.
